sentences.text: **Scheme Brief Description:** Loan scheme offering up to ₹15 lakh at 4% simple interest to unreserved category students for MBBS, PG, or equivalent courses abroad with flexible collateral and repayment conditions.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Education & Learning; Sector: International education

**Detailed Description:** The scheme provides **financial loan assistance** to students from the **unreserved category** to pursue **higher education abroad.** Loans up to **₹15 lakh** are granted at simple interest of **4% per annum**, with flexible repayment options. Security and repayment conditions depend on the loan amount. This scheme aims to support meritorious, economically weaker students for global education opportunities.

Benefits / Assistance: Loan Amount: Up to ₹15.00 lakh Interest Rate: Simple interest at 4% per annum Collateral: Up to ₹7.50 lakh: Property valued at 1.5 times the loan amount Above ₹7.50 lakh: Property equal to the loan amount Loan Repayment: Up to ₹5 lakh: repay in 5 years after 1-year moratorium Above ₹5 lakh: repay in 6 years after 1-year moratorium  Borrower can pre-pay without penalty

**Application Process:** 1. Visit the Official Website:[ **https://gueedc.gujarat.gov.in**](https://gueedc.gujarat.gov.in)1. Click on “**Register**” and fill in your basic details such as name, email, mobile number, and create a password.1. **Login** to Your Account.1. From the dashboard, select the “**Foreign Study Loan**” scheme .1. Fill the Online Application Form. 1. Upload Required Documents. 1. Submit the Application. 1. Save or note down your **unique application ID** for future reference.1. Print the Application Form. 1. Submit the signed hard copy and original documents for verification **at the GUEEDC office or as directed**.
**Contacts & Authorities:** Implementing agency: Gujarat Unreserved Educational And Economical Development Corporation; Nodal Department: Social Justice and Empowerment Department
**Tags:** Unreserved Category, Higher Education Abroad, MBBS, Master, PG Diploma
